query:
SELECT estado, COUNT(*) as cnt, 
  SUM(CAST(valorOriginal AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as totalOriginal,
  SUM(CAST(COALESCE(valorRecebidoLiquido, '0') AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as totalRecebido,
  SUM(CAST(valorOriginal AS DECIMAL(12,2))) - SUM(CAST(COALESCE(valorRecebidoLiquido, '0') AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as totalAReceber
FROM accounts_receivable 
WHERE cliente LIKE '%KEURE%'
GROUP BY estado;
